documents.docs/packing.md:
# Observatory packing

Observatory lenses must be packed in rigid cases. Foam dividers separate every pair of lenses. The issue record must contain the case number and the serial number of each lens. The receiving technician checks this record before any case is opened.
documents.docs/transport.md:
# Observatory transport

Observatory transport begins after the operator signs the issue record. The driver keeps cases upright throughout the journey. On arrival, the operator inspects the seals and records any damage. A broken seal requires inspection before equipment is used.
documents.docs/storage.md:
# Observatory storage

Observatory storage keeps the cases dry and locked. The technician records the shelf number and return date. Each lens must be inspected before storage. Any damaged lens is placed in a separate case with an inspection note attached.
